rules.no_repeats: A rage power cannot be taken twice unless it says otherwise.

options.name: Animal Fury
options.text: While raging you gain a bite attack (1d4 for Medium) usable alongside your other attacks.

options.name: Clear Mind
options.text: Once per rage, reroll a failed Will save.

options.name: Fearless Rage
options.text: While raging you cannot be shaken or frightened.

options.name: Guarded Stance
options.text: As a move action, gain a dodge bonus to AC against melee attacks for a few rounds.

options.name: Increased Damage Reduction
options.text: Your damage reduction rises by 1/- while raging.

options.name: Internal Fortitude
options.text: While raging you cannot be sickened or nauseated.

options.name: Intimidating Glare
options.text: As a move action, try to demoralize an adjacent foe with Intimidate.

options.name: Knockback
options.text: Once a round, swap a melee attack for a bull rush that also deals Strength-based damage.

options.name: Low-Light Vision
options.text: While raging you gain low-light vision.

options.name: Mighty Swing
options.text: Once per rage, automatically confirm a critical threat.

options.name: Moment of Clarity
options.text: Once per rage, set aside rage's benefits and penalties for one round.

options.name: Night Vision
options.text: While raging you gain darkvision 60 feet. Needs low-light vision: the rage power, or a race that sees in dim light.
options._requires_note: The book accepts the Low-Light Vision rage power OR the racial trait. `requires` is strict, so an elf barbarian would be refused; the either-or is left to the text until the race's senses can be asked.

options.name: No Escape
options.text: Once per rage, when a foe withdraws, move up to double speed after it.

options.name: Powerful Blow
options.text: Once per rage, add a level-scaled bonus to one damage roll.

options.name: Quick Reflexes
options.text: While raging you may take one extra attack of opportunity each round.

options.name: Raging Climber
options.text: While raging add your barbarian level to Climb checks.

options.name: Raging Leaper
options.text: While raging add your barbarian level to Acrobatics checks for jumping.

options.name: Raging Swimmer
options.text: While raging add your barbarian level to Swim checks.

options.name: Renewed Vigor
options.text: Once a day while raging, heal a few dice plus Constitution as a standard action.

options.name: Rolling Dodge
options.text: As a move action, gain a dodge bonus to AC against ranged attacks for a few rounds.

options.name: Roused Anger
options.text: You may rage while fatigued; you are exhausted when the rage ends.

options.name: Scent
options.text: While raging you gain the scent ability.

options.name: Strength Surge
options.text: Once per rage, add your barbarian level to one Strength check, combat maneuver check or CMD.

options.name: Superstition
options.text: While raging you gain a morale bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities, but refuse allies' magic.

options.name: Surprise Accuracy
options.text: Once per rage, add a level-scaled morale bonus to one attack roll.

options.name: Swift Foot
options.text: While raging your speed rises by 5 feet.

options.name: Terrifying Howl
options.text: As a standard action, howl to panic shaken enemies within 30 feet who fail a Will save.

options.name: Unexpected Strike
options.text: Once per rage, take an attack of opportunity when a foe moves into your threatened area.
